description: Activate and manage your AT&T wireless plan with AT&T AllAccess. Available on LTE and 5G enabled tablets, laptops and 2-in-1s (an AT&T SIM is required). With AT&T AllAccess you can: * Sign up for a new wireless plan, or add an LTE enabled device to your existing AT&T account. * Share your AT&T connection with friends, family, and colleagues with the Mobile Hotspot feature (applicable plan required) * Pin the app to your start screen to view real-time data usage and Mobile Hotspot status updates Compatible device required. Data charges may apply for app download and usage.
